text: A jet with no engines landed in the middle of a car race.
In nineteen eighty-three, a seven sixty-seven ran out of fuel and glided toward an old air force base in Gimli, Manitoba.
But part of the old base had become a racetrack, and that day, a race was on.
Coming in too high, the captain, a glider pilot, flew the jet sideways to drop fast.
The nose wheel collapsed, and the jet scraped to a stop, short of the people at the race.
And why did it run out of fuel? One wrong number. Full video on my channel.
